scope: Audio stream only; no global video speed filter. Still-image scene timing was retimed to the faster narration so the Short ends with its CTA.
processing: No gain normalization or sound-design changes. The source Short has only an AAC compressed audio stream; speed conversion required one AAC re-encode. This is a single lossy generation beyond the source, not restoration.
sampled_pause_rms: Several aligned source pauses measured near -90 dBFS median; no continuous music bed was evident in these samples. Full subjective listening was not performed.
